name: Delivering Daffodils
summary: In Lakeshire, you carry flowers from Martie Jainrose to Darcy, and an awkward rivalry comes to light. First, you bring lunch to Guard Parker, who asks you to collect a bouquet for Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn.

sections.title: A Fragrant Errand
sections.body: Guard Parker thanks you for bringing his lunch and asks you to fetch flowers from Martie Jainrose for Darcy, the cook who prepared his meal. Martie arranges a bouquet of daffodils, her own favorite flowers, without knowing who will receive them.

sections.title: Town Rivalries
sections.body: At the Lakeshire Inn, Darcy's delight turns to suspicion when she sees the daffodils. She knows they are Martie's favorite and considers Martie a jealous rival. Darcy fears Martie might have poisoned the stems if she had known who would receive them, but she does not blame you. She gives you hot sauteed sunfish for your trouble.

faq.answer: Darcy works at the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains, where she prepares meals for locals and town guards. She sent lunch to Guard Parker, who asked you to bring her flowers in thanks.
Martie Jainrose is Lakeshire's herbalist and a flower enthusiast. Guard Parker sends you to her for a bouquet, and she chooses daffodils, her own favorite flowers.

faq.q: Why is Darcy upset about the daffodils?
faq.answer: Darcy recognizes the daffodils as Martie's favorite flowers and considers Martie a jealous rival. She fears Martie would have poisoned the stems if she had known the bouquet was meant for Darcy.

faq.q: Did Martie actually poison the bouquet?
faq.answer: No. Martie did not know the flowers were for Darcy; Parker only asked you to pick up a bouquet, so Martie chose her own favorites.

faq.q: What quests lead up to this delivery?
faq.answer: The chain begins with A Free Lunch, where you carry Darcy's meal to Guard Parker. Parker then sends you to buy a gift from Martie Jainrose in Visit the Herbalist, which leads to Delivering Daffodils.

faq.q: What reward do you get for delivering the flowers?
faq.answer: Darcy gives you a hearty bundle of sauteed sunfish, some copper and experience, and standing with the kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: Darcy rewards you with seasoned sauteed sunfish, a taste of simple Redridge lakeside cooking.
Martie Jainrose draws on her knowledge of plants and her eye for fresh lakeside flowers, showing the quieter side of gathering herbs.
Helping the town guard and innkeeper in Lakeshire bolsters civilian morale as the town faces Blackrock and gnoll incursions.
